subject: Residency carveout during migration window — DPA addendum & subprocessor swap
messages:
From: Elena Diaz <elena.diaz@healthspark.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Lane <tom.lane@healthspark.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Residency carveout during migration window / DPA addendum ask

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this — quick background: HealthSpark is doing a regional migration for our EU tenant the week of July 12. Our compliance team needs confirmation that during the cutover window you can: (1) honor EU-region pinning for the production dataset by default, and (2) allow a temporary, documented failover period if nodes in eu-west go down and requests are routed through our dedicated capacity in us-central for remediation.

Specific asks:
- Can Redwood commit to an explicit temporary egress window (we're proposing up to 48 hours) with audit logs showing any cross-region processing?
- Do you have a DPA addendum template that covers transient cross-border processing for migrations?
- We also need the current subprocessor roster and an option to swap or delay activation of any new subprocessor during the migration week.
- If customer-managed keys or escrowed keys are options, what evidence (KMS attestation, rotation logs) can you provide ahead of the onboarding call?

We're under a tight timeline; please share what you can this week and flag anything that requires legal sign-off.

Thanks,
Elena Diaz
Sr. Security Program Manager
HealthSpark Inc

Attachments requested: subprocessor roster, DPA addendum, KMS attestation template
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Diaz <elena.diaz@healthspark.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-22T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Residency carveout during migration window / DPA addendum ask

Elena — thanks, got it. Looping in Marissa (Legal / Enterprise) and Kimberly (Infra / Ops) to scope the proposal. High level response and proposed path below.

Summary / proposed path:
- Region affinity: We can pin tenant traffic to EU by default for your account. That is our standard for regional onboarding.
- Temporary failover window: We can support an explicit, auditable transient failover of up to 48 hours as an exception for migration remediation. During that window we will: 
  * Record all cross-region requests with request-level timestamps and origin/egress region metadata
  * Generate a daily audit bundle (logs + manifests) and provide it to your security contact
- DPA addendum: Attaching a draft addendum that covers transient cross-border processing for operational migrations. It includes triggers, notification timelines, and the 48h cap.
- Subprocessor roster & swap: Attached is our current roster. We can commit to a freeze on activating new subprocessors for your tenant during the defined migration window if requested in writing at least 7 days prior.
- KMS / escrow: For Hosted API, we can provide KMS attestation documents (key ownership, rotation windows). For Private deployments we support customer-managed keys; escrow is available in our Dedicated offering — Kimberly, see note below for options and evidence we can supply.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa to review and propose redline to the DPA addendum.
2) Kimberly to confirm what telemetry/log bundle format we can provide and the KMS attestation artifacts.
3) Elena / HealthSpark to confirm migration dates and whether they'd like a subprocessor freeze.

We will target a short call (30 min) early next week to walk legal and security through the addendum and the audit bundle contents.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Security Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments sent: subprocessor_roster_2026Q2.pdf, region-failover-diagram.png, dpa-addendum-template.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, elena.diaz@healthspark.com
Date: 2026-06-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Residency carveout during migration window / DPA addendum ask

Jonas / Elena — quick legal and ops breakdown.

Legal (me):
- I'll take the draft addendum and return a redline focused on:
  * Definition: "Transient Cross-Region Processing" and precise 48-hour trigger language.
  * Notification: Redwood commits to notifying HealthSpark within 15 minutes of failover initiation and provide periodic updates (T+6h, T+24h, T+48h).
  * Evidence: We will include a delivery clause for the audit bundle (S3 link + checksum) within 24 hours of request closure.
- Two items for your team to confirm: (A) whether you need indemnity language scoped to the migration window; (B) whether you want the subprocessor freeze to be a contractual covenant or an operational confirmation.

Ops / Security (Kimberly):
- Audit bundle: We can provide per-request metadata (request_id, timestamp, model, ingress_region, egress_region, bytes_processed) and a consolidated summary CSV plus the raw logs. Format: gzipped JSONL + SHA256.
- KMS attestation: For Hosted we will supply a SOC-style attestation of our KMS controls (rotation cadence, HSM usage) and a sample key rotation log. For Dedicated we can outline the customer-managed key option and escrow process — note that escrow requires an additional onboarding step and signed escrow addendum.
- Subprocessor freeze: Ops can enforce freeze if we receive written confirmation 7 days before the start. Exception process exists for critical security fixes; changes during freeze will be escalated to both parties.

Operational ask from HealthSpark to confirm: exact migration start/end times, whether you will require a test window, and point-of-contact for collection of audit bundles.

I'll prepare the redline and route it to Elena + Tom by EOD Friday. If you want a live review, I've got 11:00–12:00 PT on Thursday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Enterprise Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Diaz <elena.diaz@healthspark.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Lane <tom.lane@healthspark.com>
Date: 2026-06-24T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Residency carveout during migration window / DPA addendum ask

Thanks — this is helpful. We are comfortable with the 48-hour transient window for the POC migration as long as audit bundles are delivered and the subprocessor freeze is in effect.

Action items from HealthSpark:
- We'll confirm migration exact dates by end of week (targeting week of July 12).
- Confirming we want the subprocessor freeze as an operational covenant for the migration window (7-day notice as you described).
- Tom (cc) will follow up on whether an indemnity sentence is required; we'll flag early if so.

Please go ahead with Marissa's redline and Kimberly's evidence package. Let's schedule the 30-minute review for next Wednesday at 09:00 PT. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-2026-087

Elena Diaz
Sr. Security Program Manager
HealthSpark Inc
